audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart called Levels 4-5 and Level 6 'Skill' and gave 2+ items to Riven, contradicting the packet chart (Riven through Level 6, Yasuo at 2+ items) and the already-audited Riven-side mirror.
audit.why: Riven's Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s) plus Valor (10/9/8/7/6s) shield-dash keep her ahead through the mid levels; Yasuo only flips once two crit items are online, which whys[6] already states.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side and win[3] -> Riven; phases[4].side and win[4] -> Riven; phases[6].side and win[6] -> Yasuo, with phases[6].rating 5/10 -> 7/10. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spike entries already track Riven's Lvl 3-5 combo window, her Level 6 Wind Slash finisher, first item, and the late-game flip; four entries present, counts unchanged.
audit.corrected: Late spike text tightened with real cooldowns rather than restructured.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly claims Wind Wall blocks Riven's Ki Burst stun (spikes[3].text, late, whys[6], wants.you[0]). Ki Burst is a 260-range point-blank AoE, not a projectile — Wind Wall does nothing to it.
audit.why: Riven's only projectile in the kit is Wind Slash, the single ranged cast granted by Blade of the Exile (120/90/60s). Wind Wall (25/23/21/19/17s, 4s) blocks that and nothing else she has.
audit.corrected: State that Wind Wall eats Wind Slash, and that Ki Burst is dodged by leaving its 260 range, not walled.

edits.before: Short cooldowns and shield sustain hold her lead through levels 4-5.
edits.after: Valor's 6s shield-dash and 7s Ki Burst hold her lead through levels 4-5.

edits.before: With two items you wall her stun and out-scale her burst kit.
edits.after: With two items you wall Wind Slash and out-scale her burst kit.

edits.before: Riven falls off relative to a fully-scaled Yasuo — at 100% crit you Wind Wall her Ki Burst (W) stun and empowered-Q autos, kite her E shield, and out-DPS her once her burst combo is on cooldown.
edits.after: Riven falls off relative to a fully-scaled Yasuo — at 100% crit Wind Wall (17s at rank 5) eats her Wind Slash (R), not Ki Burst; sidestep that and out-DPS her once Broken Wings is on its 13s cooldown.

edits.before: Riven is an early-game snowball bully who scales worse than you; once you reach two crit items you Wind Wall her stun, kite her shielded dashes, and out-DPS her the moment her burst combo goes on cooldown.
edits.after: Riven is an early-game snowball bully who scales worse than you; once you reach two crit items you wall her Wind Slash, walk out of Ki Burst's 260 range, and out-DPS her the moment Broken Wings is on cooldown.

edits.before: Wind Wall her Ki Burst (W) stun to survive the all-in combo
edits.after: Wind Wall her Wind Slash (R) — it is one projectile per ult
